en.text:
Enables hipfiring and aim down sights while in Lift and passively grants 50 Airborne Effectiveness.

Increases Lift Duration to 4 seconds:
• High Lift: 2.6🠚4 (54% increase)
• Strafe Lift: 2.2🠚4 (82% increase)
• Catapult Lift: 1🠚4 (300% increase)

Grants the following benefits while a <primary/>Primary Weapon is readied and not Aiming Down Sights:
• 5 Range and 30? Stability
• 70% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 2 degrees increased Precision Aim Cone Angle
• 20% increased Aim Assist and Damage Falloff Distance

<yellow DMT />, <yellow Last Word />, and <yellow Tommy's Matchbook /> are uniquely tuned and do not receive as significant of a benefit.
